status: Internal Test only. v0.3.25 replaces the legacy popup and floating-entry logic with a Regex-style window controller; real-device verification is required before Stable promotion.
notes: The Test release uses one draggable floating bubble as the only window entry and one extension-drawer enable/disable control.
